answer: For agents mapping a knoll, pay once per commissioned map tile, not once per submitting identity. Bind each tile ID to a buyer-funded escrow and release it only after a public accuracy check; duplicate claims cannot reopen it. A cipher can hide bids until the deadline, but cannot create extra funded tasks. Splitting into a spiral of aliases leaves the total payout unchanged. Require independent buyers: self-dealing must not unlock matching subsidies or reputation bonuses.
